# personly llms.txt

personly is an anonymous personals matching service which matches other personals instantly, making it super easy to meet people for any activity.

## URLs and Descriptions

- [Create Ticket](https://www.personly.com/ticket): Easily create a support ticket in case you have an issue that needs direct clarification.
- [Search](https://www.personly.com/search): Search all the potential matches that await you once you register and create a personal.
- [Personals](https://www.personly.com/personals): View all our personals across the entire world to see how connected we all are.
- [Features](https://www.personly.com/features): Get a complete breakdown of the features offered by personly, including anonymous tokenized personals, smart matching, and instant messaging.
- [Categories](https://www.personly.com/categories): View personals according to your favorite categories from Craigslist Personals.
- [Blog](https://www.personly.com/blog): Our blog contains the latest editorials, announcements and stories from the personly ecosystem.
- [Modern Personal Matching](https://www.personly.com/): personly is a platform for creating anonymous personals which match other personals instantly, making it super easy to meet people for any activity.
- [Organizations](https://www.personly.com/organizations): Organizations provide product, event or service based personals that match our customer's interests.
- [Go Global and Match Anyone, Anywhere](https://www.personly.com/locationless-personals-drafts-online): Check out our latest new features such as locationless personals, drafts and a new online meeting type.
- [Editors Choice Awards and Other New Features](https://www.personly.com/2025-editors-choice-awards-updates): Check out our new features such as a Consent Manager, Editors Choice Awards and improvements for organizations and the user area.
- [Personal Categories and More Updates!](https://www.personly.com/2024-third-quarter-personal-categories-more): For Q3 2024 we have introduced categories for personals as well as a revamped chat view and other numerous updates.
- [Happy 2023 Holiday Season!](https://www.personly.com/2023-third-quarter-update-personals): All the latest of updates for end of 2023 including the new live personals view as we prepare for a new year.
- [Omegle Shutdown and the Future of Anonymity](https://www.personly.com/omegle-anonymous-meetup-platforms-future): We examine the factors that led to downfall of Omegle and what this means for anonymity based platforms such as personly
- [Craigslist Shorts: The Great Impostor](https://www.personly.com/craigslist-shorts-great-impostor): Read a great short story about meeting impersonators on Craigslist Personals and how the community came to help
- [Strictly Platonic Personals: All a Hoax?](https://www.personly.com/strictly-platonic-personals-all-a-hoax): We discuss the disingenuous past of strictly platonic personals and how personly makes matching them fun again!
- [2023 3rd Quarter Updates](https://www.personly.com/3rd-quarter-updates-2023): Get the latest scoop on all the UI/UX changes to personals management in the members area in Q3 2023.
- [2023 2nd Quarter Updates](https://www.personly.com/2nd-quarter-updates-2023): See what we have been up to in Q2 2023 with an announcement concerning our frontend infrastructure update.
- [2023 1st Quarter Updates](https://www.personly.com/seo-organization-personals-update-2023): The latest happenings on personly including improved SEO and big plans for cross promoting events as an organization through personals!
- [A Tale of a Footstool](https://www.personly.com/craigslist-personals-footstool-legacy): Discover how personly improves the legacy of Craigslist Personals by creating a safe anonymous space for human interaction.
- [Christmas 2022 Updates](https://www.personly.com/christmas-2022-update): A summary of updates for the New Year including a splash page overhaul which now displays all open personals on personly.
- [October 2022 Updates](https://www.personly.com/october-2022-update): A summary of the events over the last two months including preparations for a mobile app as well as an architectural overhaul.
- [August 2022 Updates](https://www.personly.com/august-2022-update):  The latest updates of what has been happening at personly over the summer including removal of the map view as well as usability improvements.
- [Token Based Pay as you Go: The Future?](https://www.personly.com/token-based-the-future): See how token-based services integrate nicely with payment systems in order to create affordable and inclusive user experiences.
- [Personal Wanderlust](https://www.personly.com/tokenised-personals-travelling): See how personly can help wandering hearts create by simultaneously matching personals across many cities.
- [Social Media Malaise and Online Dating](https://www.personly.com/social-media-online-dating): Are the negative aspects of social media starting to influence popular dating platforms and cause depression amongst their users?
- [Goodbye Craigslist Personals. Long live personly!](https://www.personly.com/goodbye-craigslist-longlive-personly): The inaugural post introducing personly, the platform for creating anonymous personals which match other personals instantly.
- [FAQ](https://www.personly.com/faq): We answer some questions about personly including what are personals, what are tokens, as well as our business model.
- [About](https://www.personly.com/about): Learn about personly including our mission, our features, and our future direction in the About section.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.personly.com/privacy-policy): Read through this section to understand how personly processes and stores your personal information.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.personly.com/terms-of-service): Read our Terms of Service to understand the implicit legal agreement between personly and users of this service.
- [Support](https://www.personly.com/support): Navigate through our knowledge base articles to understand how the major features of the platform function
- [Imprint](https://www.personly.com/imprint): Contact us through traditional means such as email or mail or through one of our social media channels.
